title: Marketing Speak (Stephan Spencer) — Eric: 'companies that we used to see through the lens of such idealism are now monsters'
summary: Stephan Spencer — SEO and digital-marketing author (Google Power Search, The Art of SEO) with 101K+ X following — hosts Eric for a 47-minute Incorruptible conversation on his Marketing Speak podcast. Covers why Lean Startup still holds up in the AI era, mission guardianship over stated values, the low-information diet, and why the timing of a protective structural decision matters as much as the decision itself.
blockquote: I've seen the very best that this industry has to offer, but I've also seen the dark side of it. I've seen people lose control of their companies. I've seen companies go public and then get ruined, forcibly taken over, founders ejected. Companies that we used to see through the lens of such idealism are now monsters and we see as some of the most evil companies in the world.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Marketing Speak with Stephan Spencer
attribution_title: Host, Marketing Speak podcast; SEO author (The Art of SEO, Google Power Search)
